releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.4.14

- Adds exact 1-second power and watts per kilogram to the season power radar.
- Leaves the 1-second percentile line blank because Intervals.icu supplies age-group rankings from 5 seconds onward; Bike Sync does not substitute or invent a percentile.
- Keeps ordinary automatic app updates password-free after the initial installation. Developer release signing is separate from the update that runs on an athlete's Mac.
- Uses only one developer-identity signing operation per completed release build and a stable publisher helper, preventing the repeated release-time password cascade that occurred during 2.4.13.
- Moves the separate saved connections into one app-owned Keychain vault. Existing connections migrate once, then future launches and updates open one stable record rather than six.
